question: At which theatre was the Ariana Grande Bang Bang live performance recorded?
answer_note: The iHeartRadio Theater LA. The opening title card is on screen 1-3 s and reads 'ARIANA GRANDE ON THE / Honda STAGE / AT THE iHeartRadio THEATER LA'.

question: Who is credited as the creator on the title card of the animated short about emotions?
answer_note: ARiiMiA. A black card carries the handwritten name 'ARiiMiA' from 4 s to 5 s, followed by the title 'EMOTIONS' at 6 s.

question: Where is the modern Christmas tree believed to have started?
answer_note: 16th-century Germany. Narration at 28.0-32.3 s: 'the modern Christmas tree is believed to have started in 16th century Germany'.

question: What is the admission price for visiting the Galleria Borghese today?
answer_note: Unanswerable. Video 611 shows the Villa Borghese and says at 403.7-410.6 s that it is a public museum today, but never gives a ticket price, and no other video in the corpus mentions one.

question: What kind of cutting mat does the paper cutting tutorial say you need?
answer_note: A self-healing cutting mat. Narration at 30.0-35.3 s: 'first of all you're going to need a self-healing cutting mat and the second thing is a scalpel'.

question: Why does the paper cutting tutorial cut away the spare paper around a template before starting?
answer_note: To make the sheet smaller so it is less likely to catch on the edges of the cutting mat. Narration at 86.2-106.4 s: 'I like to cut around the paper that's not needed as part of the template ... to make the paper size smaller so it's less likely to catch on the edges of the paper cutting mat'.

question: How long does a year last on Mercury, according to the French solar system lesson?
answer_note: 88 days. Burnt-in bilingual subtitle on screen 179-183 s: 'Oui et la-bas une annee dure 88 jours. / Yes and over there a year lasts 88 days', beside a sign reading '88 jours'.

question: How many Earth years does Saturn need to travel once around the Sun?
answer_note: 29.5 Earth years. Subtitle on screen 474-481 s: 'Saturne a besoin de 29,5 annees terrestres pour faire le tour du soleil ! / Saturn needs 29.5 Earth years to go around the sun!', beside a sign reading '29,5 annees'.

question: Which two other games does the League of Legends video compare League's new direction to?
answer_note: Overwatch and Rainbow Six. Narration at 133.0-135.0 s: 'a pair of good games to compare it to would be Overwatch and Rainbow Six'; gameplay from both follows from 165 s.

question: What joke taunt about Riot appears on screen near the end of the League of Legends video?
answer_note: 'Well my mom works for Riot and she's going to ban you' - a champion taunt card on screen 482-486 s.

question: How many calories are in the avocado toast breakfast?
answer_note: Unanswerable. Video 831 makes and describes the avocado toast at 171-200 s but never states a calorie count, and no video in the corpus gives nutrition numbers.

question: What is the name of the first magician to perform in the America's Got Talent magicians compilation?
answer_note: Kevin Li. A yellow lower-third name card reading 'KEVIN LI' is on screen 2-6 s.

question: What job does Magic Mike Jacobson say he does by day?
answer_note: He works in advertising. At 1615.0-1620.0 s, asked whether he makes a living from magic, he answers 'No, not yet. I work in advertising by day'. His name card is on screen 1577-1581 s.

question: Which episode does the Suits compilation open with?
answer_note: The Pilot - Season 1, Episode 1. A caption reading '"PILOT" / SEASON 1, EPISODE 1' sits bottom-left from 1 s to 5 s.

question: What breed of cat does Louis promise his partner she will never have to get?
answer_note: A Maine Coon. Dialogue at 2777.3-2778.3 s: 'I promise I will never bring it up again. You never have to get a Maine Coon.'

question: What did Bernini reportedly do to his own leg to model a tortured expression?
answer_note: He held it against a red-hot brazier and sketched his own pained face in a mirror. Narration at 353.6-365.0 s; flames are superimposed over the marble face 356-361 s.

question: In which century did critics begin to restore Bernini's artistic reputation?
answer_note: The 20th century. Narration at 1759.0-1773.0 s: 'in the 20th century critics began to recognise Bernini's achievements and slowly began to restore his artistic reputation'.

question: Which of the magicians went on to win America's Got Talent that year?
answer_note: Unanswerable. Video 791 is an audition compilation that ends on the last act's performance at 2032 s; no winner is announced anywhere in it, and nothing else in the corpus says.

question: What breakfast does she make after her Monday morning Pilates session?
answer_note: Avocado toast on sourdough. Narration at 160.0-183.8 s: 'Today is Monday and I just finished a full body Pilates flow ... I'm gonna make an avocado toast ... This is sourdough'. An on-screen clock reads 8:00 AM from 164 s.

question: Which country does she say she used to live in?
answer_note: Zimbabwe. At 1521.2-1529.0 s, describing a dried beef snack: 'it reminds me of my days in Africa when I was living in Zimbabwe'.
